prompt: Complete CargoVan, a subclass of the provided abstract RoadVehicle: chain the constructor with super, implement the van's own annualCost formula, and override summary() so it prefixes the inherited text.
explanation: An abstract method is the hook a base class leaves open so each subclass can supply its own cost model while everything else -- the plate, the price, the summary text -- is written once in the superclass. The subclass constructor must hand the shared fields up with super(...) before it initialises its own, because the base class owns those private fields. Calling super.summary() inside an override lets the subclass ADD to inherited behaviour instead of copying it.
hints: The first statement of the CargoVan constructor must be the super(...) call passing the plate and purchase price up; only then may you set the payload field.
purchasePrice is private in RoadVehicle, so read it through the inherited getPurchasePrice() method.
An override can still reach the version it replaced, so summary() should prefix its tag onto super.summary() rather than rebuilding the whole sentence.
